title: User Authentication - Successful Login
description: Verify that a user can log in successfully with valid credentials and is granted access according to their role.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter a valid username/email and correct password.
Submit the login form.
Verify user is successfully authenticated and redirected to the dashboard according to role.

title: User Authentication - Login Failure with Invalid Credentials
description: Verify that login fails when invalid credentials are provided, showing appropriate error message.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter invalid username/email and/or password.
Submit the login form.
Verify error message is displayed and user is not authenticated.

title: Password Recovery Flow
description: Verify that a user is able to initiate password recovery and reset password via email.

steps.description: Navigate to the password recovery page.
Enter registered email address.
Submit the password recovery request.
Verify that a password reset email is sent.
Follow the reset link and enter a new valid password.
Confirm that the password is successfully updated and user can login with new password.

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Verify that users cannot access pages or functions not permitted by their assigned roles.

steps.description: Login as a user with limited permissions (e.g., patient or receptionist).
Attempt to access admin-only pages or features.
Confirm access is denied and proper error or redirect is shown.
Login as an administrator.
Verify access to all admin functionalities.
Confirm successful authorized access.

title: Patient Registration - Valid New Patient
description: Verify the full patient registration flow including required fields and successful creation.

steps.description: Navigate to the patient registration page.
Fill in all mandatory fields with valid data.
Submit the registration form.
Verify patient is created successfully and appears in patient list.

title: Patient Registration - Validation on Missing Required Fields
description: Verify that validation errors appear when required fields are missing or invalid during patient registration.

steps.description: Navigate to the patient registration page.
Fill fields leaving required fields blank or invalid.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
Verify validation error messages are displayed for each missing or invalid field.

title: Patient Medical Record Editing and Auto-Save
description: Verify editing the patient’s medical records including anamnese, exame físico, and pain map saves automatically without loss.

steps.description: Access an existing patient’s medical record.
Modify anamnesis and physical exam fields.
Interact with the interactive pain map to update pain areas.
Confirm that changes are auto-saved periodically without explicit save.
Refresh the page.
Verify that the updates persist after refresh.

title: Appointment Scheduling - Create and Conflict Detection
description: Verify appointment creation with valid inputs and system detects scheduling conflicts with warnings.

steps.description: Navigate to the appointment scheduling module.
Create a new appointment for a patient in an available time slot.
Confirm appointment is created and visible in the calendar.
Attempt to create another appointment that conflicts with an existing one for the same professional.
Confirm system shows a conflict warning and prevents double booking.

title: Appointment Scheduling - Waitlist Management
description: Verify proper handling of patients in the waitlist and notifying when slots become available.

steps.description: Add a patient to the waitlist for a fully booked date and time.
Confirm patient appears in waitlist view.
Cancel an existing appointment freeing up a slot.
Verify patient on waitlist is notified automatically and can be scheduled.

title: Treatment Module - SOAP Form Auto-Save and Replication
description: Verify soap note form auto-save functionality and replication of treatment conduct to other sessions.

steps.description: Open a treatment session and fill out the SOAP form partially.
Verify the form auto-saves the data without manual save action.
Replicate treatment conduct from a previous session to current session.
Confirm replicated data fills the form correctly and allows editing.

title: Financial Management - Payment Creation and Stripe Integration
description: Verify creation of payments and financial transactions and successful integration with Stripe payment gateway.

steps.description: Navigate to the financial payments module.
Create a payment transaction for a patient’s session or package.
Confirm the payment is recorded correctly in the system.
Process a payment via Stripe integration.
Verify payment completes successfully and status updates in system.

title: Financial Management - Invalid Payment Data Handling
description: Verify validation errors shown for invalid financial inputs and failed payment attempts.

steps.description: Attempt to create a payment with invalid/missing mandatory fields.
Validate appropriate error messages are displayed.
Simulate a declined payment via Stripe.
Confirm the system handles the failure gracefully and notifies the user.

title: Marketing Automation - Send Campaigns and Patient Reactivation
description: Verify the marketing module can send automated WhatsApp, SMS, and email campaigns to inactive patients and reactivate them.

steps.description: Access the marketing campaigns interface.
Create and configure a patient reactivation campaign targeting inactive patients.
Send the campaign via enabled channels.
Verify campaign messages are sent successfully and patients receive correct notifications.
Monitor patient activity post-campaign.
Confirm that reactivated patients are updated correctly in the system.

title: Artificial Intelligence - Clinical Report Generation and Suggestions
description: Verify AI generates automated clinical reports (laudos) and provides treatment suggestions effectively based on patient data.

steps.description: Access a patient treatment session.
Trigger AI assistant to generate report and treatment suggestions.
Verify generated reports are coherent, complete, and relevant.
Confirm suggestions align with clinical guidelines and patient history.

title: Real-time Movement Analysis with MediaPipe
description: Verify system captures and analyzes patient exercise movements in real-time and provides actionable feedback.

steps.description: Initiate real-time movement analysis for a patient performing exercises.
Check system detects movements accurately using MediaPipe and overlays feedback.
Perform complex or edge movement patterns to test robustness.
Confirm feedback and analysis remain reliable without crashes or lag.

title: Gamification - Points and Achievement Unlocking
description: Verify patient engagement gamification features including earning points, unlocking achievements, and leaderboard updates.

steps.description: Complete activities that award points in the system.
Confirm points are accumulated correctly and displayed.
Reach achievement triggers and verify notifications and unlocks.
Leaderboard updates reflect current standings accurately.

title: Patient Portal - Secure Access and Data Visibility
description: Verify that patients can securely log into the portal and access only their own data including exercises, history, and communications.

steps.description: Patient logs in with valid credentials.
Confirm access is granted only to their own records.
Attempt to access another patient's data directly via URL.
Verify access is denied with appropriate security enforcement.

title: Admin Panel - User Management and Waitlist Control
description: Verify administrative capabilities to create/edit users, assign roles, monitor KPIs, and manage the waitlist efficiently.

steps.description: Login as administrator.
Create a new user with defined role and permissions.
Verify new user is listed with correct role and can log in accordingly.
Access waitlist management and modify patient positions.
Confirm changes saved and reflected in patient scheduling.
View KPIs and dashboard panels.
Confirm accurate real-time display of metrics.

title: LGPD Compliance - Data Privacy and Audit Trails
description: Verify all personal data handling complies with LGPD, including user consent, data encryption, and auditability of actions.

steps.description: Perform actions involving personal data creation, modification, and deletion.
Verify audit logs are created for each action with timestamp and user identification.
Attempt unauthorized data export or access.
Confirm system blocks illegal access and logs security events.

title: Performance Testing - Load Time and Responsiveness
description: Verify that main pages and critical workflows load within 2 seconds under normal load conditions.

steps.description: Use automated tools to measure page load times for dashboard, patient management, scheduling, and financial modules.
Confirm load times are below 2 seconds for 95% of requests.
Simulate multiple concurrent users performing workflows.
Verify system remains responsive with no crashes or errors.

title: Backup and Recovery Process Verification
description: Verify that scheduled backups occur correctly and data recovery procedures restore system state without loss.

steps.description: Trigger automated backup process or execute scheduled backup.
Confirm backup completes successfully without errors.
Perform data recovery using a backup snapshot.
Verify data integrity and consistency post-recovery.

title: Notification System - Reminder Delivery via Multiple Channels
description: Verify that appointment reminders and important communications are sent automatically via WhatsApp, SMS, and email.

steps.description: Schedule an appointment with future date and time.
Verify reminders are sent automatically through enabled communication channels at configured times.
Simulate communication failure on one channel.
Confirm fallback or retry mechanisms trigger and alerts are logged.
